title: Factorial inverse identity
statement: For natural numbers $j$ and $k$ with $k \le j$, the product of the reciprocals of $k!$ and $(j-k)!$ equals $\binom{j}{k}$ times the reciprocal of $j!$: $\frac{1}{k!}\frac{1}{(j-k)!}=\binom{j}{k}\frac{1}{j!}$.
